owner_request: Populate the JSON/JSONL collection as the authoritative, complete source of all free-content research analysis. Capture every identified source, all existing analysis/evidence, query methods, ten verified examples for every retained queryable source, decisions, blockers and next actions. Actively continue through the full discovery goal rather than stopping after a daily quota or an initial shortlist.

milestones.objective: Backfill all existing free-content research/design documents, evidence, assets and project backlog with version/hash provenance; map all historical source-catalog rows and expose unresolved entity/analysis gaps.
Persist the first ten candidates with ten distinct positive query examples each.
Triage every existing playbook lead, resolving named/unlinked candidates; give each actual catalog a canonical identity and reviewed/deferred/rejected decision.

Complete evidence-backed source dossiers: identity/deduplication, coverage, query contract, rights/cost, reader access, quality/relevance, operating limits, decision/follow-up; keep every missing check and contradiction explicit.

Extend discovery through all six groups, 20 content categories, 20 industry tags and nine USA/India public tracks. Work toward 100 qualified origins per category/industry where evidence supports it; document genuine shortfalls.

counting_rules: A URL or directory is a lead, not a source. Deduplicate origins, language variants, mirrors and shared connectors.
Only latest successful observations of distinct current query requests count toward ten; failures/retries/empty results do not.
Ten known-item searches verify retrieval only; production qualification needs topic relevance, rights, reliability, access and UI tests.
Record overlap, geography and India/USA gaps; never inflate counts to meet a target.

execution.batch_size: Small checkpoints, not a completion quota. Continue productive independent work within each run budget; resume hourly without waiting for new user requests.

constraints: Research only; do not enable app sources, import runtime catalogs or deploy.
No new database service, SQL, Redis, paid API or account setup.
No CAPTCHA/WAF bypass or bulk full-work copying; retain small metadata evidence.
Free reader login is acceptable when the catalog is queryable; label account requirements and do not create accounts automatically.
completion_definition: All existing analysis/evidence is captured with reproducible provenance; every identified linked or named lead has a canonical triage decision; every retained queryable source has a complete dossier and ten current verified examples; blocked/rejected cases retain evidence, missing checks and reconsideration triggers; every category/industry and USA/India public-information cell has accounted-for coverage. Expansion continues toward the agreed targets; genuine shortfalls need explicit acceptance. A saved plan, imported claim, URL count or scheduled task alone never means completion.
